name: smwmusic-golden-sun-saturos-battle
title: Golden Sun - Saturos Battle
description:
Part of RednGreen's C3 music pack.

Again, one of my favorite tracks from Golden Sun. I originally wanted to make it unsampled, but I previously managed to rip GBA samples so I made a try. Then I realized the sawtooth synth sounded horrible. So I replaced it with @1.
